This table is to calculate mileage, transit times, and the day authorized SIT for direct delivery shipments through using shipment weight and the Zip3's (first three digits of the zip) for the origin and destination of the non-Alaska domestic shipments.   If the Miles results show "DTOD", you will need to refer to DTOD for mileage because the Origin Zip3 and the Destination Zip3 are within the same base point location.  If the Miles result is "Invalid Origin", "Invalid Destination" or "Invalid Origin/Destin", the Zip3 is does not exist, is an Alaska Zip3, or is not in our mileage table.  In this case, check and make sure the appropriate Zip3 was entered correctly.
